change.ask: A finance core: invoices, receivables, bills and payables, a chart of accounts and general ledger, bank reconciliation, VAT and WHT; or an accounting system the hub posts to.
change.why: No milestone (M0 to M11, MILESTONES.md) includes accounting. Money in the hub is limited to payroll (M6), expense requests and budgets (M8) and partnership returns (M7); none keeps a ledger. Ruled out of scope by JBS Praxis, 24/11/2026.
change.cover: Build or integrate. If integrate: the accounting system chosen, what the hub posts to it (payroll journals, paid expenses, partnership returns), how often, who reconciles, and the permissions on both sides.
change.recommend: Integrate an accounting package rather than build a ledger in the hub. Scope it after go-live.

change.ask: Products, stock, orders, ticket sales and revenue recorded in the hub, so revenue goals can be measured.
change.why: No milestone covers products, inventory, orders or ticket sales. Performance goals (M2) hold targets and progress; they do not record sales. Ruled out of scope by JBS Praxis, 24/11/2026.
change.cover: Which revenue streams to measure, their source (the MyCity apps' own transaction data rather than typing), ticket and listing inventory, partner settlements, and which goals each figure feeds.
change.recommend: Feed revenue figures from the apps' own data into Performance goals; do not build inventory in the hub.

change.ask: Stop the Mailbox making three failing calls on each folder visit before an account is connected.
change.why: Mailbox was offered as a change request, which MyCity declined, so it is not part of the go-live scope (JBS Praxis, 24/11/2026).
change.cover: Only if MyCity takes Mailbox up again: this fix goes in with it (check the connection first and skip the folder calls).
change.recommend: Decide whether Mailbox stays visible at go-live. If it is taken up later, include this fix.

change.ask: Customer records, a support ticket queue and marketing campaign records.
change.why: The CRM contracted in Milestone 7 is a partner CRM (MILESTONES §12 and its Definition of done). No milestone has customers, tickets or campaigns.
change.cover: A customer record linked to app transactions and enquiries (data source and privacy basis), a ticket queue (channels, response times, assignment, statuses), campaign records feeding the Branding & Marketing KPIs, and the app integrations behind them.
change.recommend: Discuss after go-live; most of this belongs in the MyCity apps' own support tools.

change.ask: An offboarding step that forces every record a leaver owns to a new owner before the employee is archived.
change.why: No milestone has an offboarding workflow. Records are handed over one by one on each screen, as agreed (partnerships guide §11).
change.cover: An Offboard step on Archive Record listing everything the person owns (partnership records, projects and tasks, department headship, report audiences, waiting approvals, open proposals), with a new owner required for each, in one transaction.
change.recommend: Worth doing: it prevents the stranded records found in F06. Small enough to agree quickly.

change.ask: A per-employee exemption from pension or PAYE, with a reason and evidence.
change.why: Not part of the agreed payroll scope (MILESTONES §11 and its amendments of 08/11, 11/11 and 12/11/2026; payroll guide §13.1 items 41 to 46).
change.cover: Which exemptions apply, each with its legal source; a per-employee switch with reason, evidence document and dates; how the run and the statutory report treat it.
change.recommend: Confirm first whether any MyCity employee qualifies. If none does, decline.

change.kind: Outside the agreed scope; Changes an agreed decision
change.ask: A supplier list kept by Finance with checked bank details, payees picked from it; an invoice required above a set amount; purchase orders for capital spending.
change.why: The contract has payee bank details typed on each request (MILESTONES §13 amended 04/11/2026). The invoice is asked for but optional, and there is no amount threshold anywhere, by decision (expenses guide §6.1 rule 2; 04/11/2026). Purchase orders are procurement, part of the finance core ruled out of scope.
change.cover: A supplier register (name, verified bank details, who may edit it, audit), picking a payee from it on New Request; an invoice rule by amount; a purchase order record, its approval, and matching an invoice and payment to it.
change.recommend: The supplier list is the most useful part; consider it with the finance core decision (CR for F03).

change.ask: An approval step and an effective date for each pay change, with the before and after figures on the record.
change.why: Pay changes were scoped as an edit on the employee record, checked when the CEO approves each payroll run (MILESTONES §11 and its amendments; payroll guide §13.1). The Audit Log already keeps the before and after values.
change.cover: A pay-change request (new figure, reason, effective month) through a Settings · Approvals flow, payroll reading the figure in force for the run's month, and the record showing pending changes.
change.recommend: Worth doing before many pay changes are made in the hub; agree it as a change request.

change.ask: A rule that each approval stage of a money flow is a different person.
change.why: The agreed approval engine stops people approving their own requests and lets the CEO act at any stage (MILESTONES §5, A11, amended 14/10/2026: port it as it is).
change.cover: A per-flow "different person at each stage" setting, whether the CEO exception still applies, and what happens when only one eligible person remains.
change.recommend: Discuss with the CEO; at MyCity's size the CEO exception is often needed.

change.ask: Stop staff adding new bank names that everyone is then offered.
change.why: Typing a bank not on the list was agreed at the 11/11/2026 review, because the list cannot hold every microfinance bank (expenses guide §6.1 rule 7).
change.cover: Offer only the common list plus banks named on requests that were paid, so a name typed on a draft, cancelled or rejected request is never suggested to others.
change.recommend: Accept: small, and it keeps the agreed freedom to type a bank.

change.ask: Make a duplicate organisation require an explicit Create Anyway with a reason.
change.why: A duplicate is warned, never blocked, by decision (partnerships guide §6.2, §11), so a genuinely separate organisation with a similar name can be added.
change.cover: A Create Anyway confirmation with a reason, kept on the record's history.
change.recommend: Accept if MyCity wants it; it pairs with the better matching in F54b.

change.ask: Reserve a request's amount as Committed when it is sent, and refuse spending against a project with no budget.
change.why: Committed counts approved requests only, and a project's budget is optional, both by decision (expenses guide §6.6 rules 2 and 6; handoff decision 7). The department budget check applies to every request.
change.cover: A Pending column (or Committed from sending), and a rule that a project with spending must have a budget, with what happens to existing projects.
change.recommend: Pair with F56b (warn on the form). A separate Pending figure is clearer than changing what Committed means.

change.ask: Send a manager's own expense request to their line manager before Operations & People.
change.why: A request from anyone who manages people goes straight to Operations & People, as agreed at the 04/11/2026 review (handoff m8-expenses §1 item 1).
change.cover: A change to the expense route on Settings · Approvals; no code, since the route is configurable (A11).
change.recommend: MyCity's call; it can be changed on Settings · Approvals without a release.

change.ask: Require a due date and a budget when a project becomes Active.
change.why: Due dates and budgets are optional on projects by decision (workspace guide §3 step 14; expenses guide §6.6 rule 6); budgets are set on Expenses · Projects.
change.cover: A required due date on Active projects; a budget rule as in the F56 row.
change.recommend: Require the due date only; leave budgets to Expenses.

change.ask: Confirm before completing a project that still has open tasks, and offer to close or move them.
change.why: Completing a project leaves its open tasks in place and it can be reopened, by decision (workspace guide §11).
change.cover: A confirmation naming how many tasks stay open.
change.recommend: Accept: small and avoids surprise.

change.ask: Require a reason the moment a task goes overdue.
change.why: The reason is asked when an overdue task is opened or completed, and Analytics reports overdue tasks by reason (workspace guide §3 step 12; A24).
change.cover: A daily reminder to the assignee asking for a reason, and the reason's place on the task.
change.recommend: Decline for now; the Overdue Tasks rule on Queries & Sanctions covers repeat lateness (see MyCity Actions).

change.ask: Block or require a reason when a candidate moves on with a failed screening, an unfinished test or no interview card.
change.why: Free movement between stages was agreed for M4: scores and tests inform the recruiter but never move or block anyone (recruitment guide §6.3, §6.4; MILESTONES §9).
change.cover: A required reason (kept in Stage History) when a card leaves a stage with an unfinished sitting, no submitted interview card or a screening score under a threshold MyCity sets.
change.recommend: Accept the reason prompt; do not block moves.

change.ask: Require a pay range on every vacancy.
change.why: A band is optional on purpose, since some roles are advertised before pay is settled (recruitment guide §6.1, §10.1). Offers outside a set band are flagged to the approver.
change.cover: A required band on publishing, or a minimum wage floor on offers once MyCity enters the minimum wage on Payroll · Configurations.
change.recommend: Take the minimum wage floor on offers instead of a required band.

change.ask: One combined, non-blocking prompt for every policy waiting to be acknowledged.
change.why: One acknowledgement sheet per owed policy, one after another, was agreed (policies guide P3, §6.7).
change.cover: A combined prompt linking to Self-Service · Policy Updates, and how long before the screen is blocked.
change.recommend: MyCity's call; either works.

change.ask: Count a Saturday as half a day of leave.
change.why: Leave is counted in working days and Saturday is a working day (A22; ess guide §6).
change.cover: Half-day leave units, the leave balance precision, and every report that shows days.
change.recommend: Only if MyCity's written leave policy says so.

change.ask: Refuse or flag a clock-in after the shift has ended.
change.why: A late arrival is recorded, never refused, and counted late from the start time (attendance guide §1.1 T2, §6.14).
change.cover: A new Attendance policy rule (flag or refuse) and its exception.
change.recommend: Flag, do not refuse, if MyCity wants it.

change.ask: Stop showing staff the tokens and naira cost of their own AI questions.
change.why: Each person sees what their own questions cost, as decided when History was built (praxis-ai guide §1.1 decision 7, §10.1; 22/10/2026).
change.cover: Show the Tokens and Cost columns and Your Spend to AI Control holders only.
change.recommend: Accept: small, and cost belongs on AI Control.

recon.title: The CRM covers partners only, not customers, support or campaigns
recon.reason: No customer records, support tickets or marketing campaigns. The hub's CRM is a partner CRM, as contracted in Milestone 7. Customer records, support tickets and campaigns are not in any milestone; we can scope them in a Change Report if you want them.

recon.title: No supplier list: payee bank details are typed free-hand on each request
recon.verdict: Split: By design, Improvement, Out of scope
recon.went: Bugs & Gaps: BG-018; also CR-10, CR-07
recon.reason: F09a: Any requester can add a new bank name that everyone is then offered (By design). F09b: Invoice is optional and there are no purchase orders (By design). F09c: Account name and number are not checked against the payee (Improvement). F09d: No supplier master list maintained by Finance (Out of scope).

recon.title: Two-step sign-in is off for everyone, including admins and payroll
recon.reason: F10a: Two-step sign-in not yet required for any role (MyCity action). F10b: Some staff logins use personal Gmail addresses (MyCity action).

recon.title: Payroll allows staff without bank details
recon.reason: F11a: Bank Details Required switched on mid-month misses this month's run (Bug). F11b: No Bank Details is a warning unless the switch is on (MyCity action).

recon.title: Totals use different, unlabelled definitions (new records count correctly)

recon.title: Approvals route to vacant seats and to the requester themself
recon.reason: F13a: Requests from staff under a vacant seat go above it (Not reproduced). F13b: Nobody but the CEO can approve their own request (Not reproduced). F13c: CEO decides own review and both offer stages (By design).

recon.title: Attendance data is too sparse to rely on
recon.reason: F14a: Attendance adoption and when to switch sanctions on (MyCity action). F14b: Devices marked New need no approval from anyone (By design).

recon.title: Policy pop-ups chain one after another on every page load
recon.reason: F15a: One acknowledge sheet per owed policy, one after another (By design). F15b: Overdue policy sheet returns on every page reload, not every sign-in (Bug).

recon.title: Sidebar badges don't say what they count
recon.reason: F16a: Menu and tab counts do not say they are unread notices (Improvement). F16b: More's count adds up every module behind it (By design).

recon.title: Test records show up in company-level views
recon.reason: QA and test records typed on staging, not seeded. These records were typed into staging during testing and are not in our seed files. Production starts clean, so they will not appear at go-live; delete them on staging if they get in the way.

recon.title: Attendance chart caption contradicts the chart
recon.reason: Fixed caption on Home attendance chart can contradict the data. Confirmed: the caption is fixed text, so it can disagree with what the chart shows. We will remove it or show it only when the data bears it out.

recon.title: Alert ages contradict their titles, and some alerts are duplicated
recon.verdict: Split: By design, Not reproduced, Improvement
recon.reason: F19a: Alert Age is how long the alert is open, not the wait (By design). F19b: Two Temporary Site alerts are two separate requests (Not reproduced). F19c: Approval alert title omits what the request is (Improvement). F19d: Alert Sources counts include alerts already cleared (By design).

recon.title: Scheduled reports show no runs
recon.reason: F20a: Scheduled report runs are recorded but shown to recipients only (Not reproduced). F20b: Recipients card counts running schedules only (By design).

recon.title: Two status systems for deals, and the last stage is never reached
recon.reason: F21a: Lead status and deal stage seen as two status systems (By design). F21b: Thirteen stages, and Active Partnership stage stays empty (MyCity action).

recon.title: Lead source is hidden and optional, so source reporting is empty

recon.title: 'Last Contact' is not rolled up from interactions
recon.verdict: Split: Fixed since audit, By design
recon.reason: F23a: Converted lead showed Last Contact Never (Fixed since audit). F23b: Never in the list but Today in the record header (By design).

recon.title: Partner screen is cramped: filters take half the screen and the detail is squeezed
recon.reason: Partner screen cramped beside its list. This was changed on 16/11 after your earlier feedback: each partner, lead, proposal and agreement now opens on its own full page, filters sit in one row, and the stage is a compact seven-step bar. Please recheck on staging.

recon.title: Duplicate API calls

recon.title: Locked tabs are still shown

recon.title: AI history shows staff the token count and naira cost of each question

recon.title: Announcement banner takes a full row on every screen

The red bar is how an Urgent announcement was agreed to work: it stays on every screen until each person acknowledges it. Press Acknowledge on the bar to clear it, and post routine news as Normal or Important so it does not take the bar.

recon.title: Organogram has an extra vacant CEO seat
recon.reason: F37a: Extra vacant CEO seat entered on staging (MyCity action). F37b: No Close Role button for an open role on screen (Improvement).

recon.title: Departments overlap and their codes are inconsistent

recon.title: Wrong avatar initials for multi-word names
recon.reason: Avatar initials take the first and last word. Initials take the first and last name for everyone. JT belongs to our own build account, which is switched off at handover.

recon.title: Automatic queries show the rule name as the person who raised them
recon.reason: Rule-raised queries show the rule's bare name under Raised By. Showing the rule that raised a query is intended, but the label should make clear it is a rule and not a person. We will prefix it with "Rule:".

recon.title: Raw internal key in Record History
recon.reason: Record History shows raw event keys for events it has no words for. Confirmed: some entries in Record History show a system name instead of words. We will word every entry and leave reminders out of the record's history.

recon.title: Hours worked don't match the clock-out shown
recon.reason: Day sheet does not say a System Clock-Out counts to shift end. The hours are correct: an automatic clock-out counts only to the end of the shift, and the person can press Give Real Time. We will add that explanation on the day itself.

recon.title: Duplicate and incomplete projects
recon.verdict: Split: MyCity action, Improvement, By design
recon.went: Bugs & Gaps: BG-027; also CR-14, MA-24
recon.reason: F43a: Duplicate projects on staging were typed there, not seeded (MyCity action). F43b: No warning when a new project repeats an existing name (Improvement). F43c: Due date and budget are not required on a project (By design).

recon.title: Typos in master data
recon.reason: Typos in job titles, a category and a goal entered on staging. These spellings were typed on staging and are not in anything we load. Please correct them there and in the data prepared for go-live.

recon.title: Analytics figures have no units
recon.reason: Analytics charts lacked units. Charts now show their units (deals, naira, app downloads), and every measure in the lead owner table has a short definition behind its help mark.

recon.title: Region field adds nothing
recon.reason: Region pre-selected as National on new records. New Lead and New Partner no longer choose a region for you. The records that all read National are our staging demonstration data and do not go to production.

recon.title: Mailbox fires failing calls when no account is connected
recon.reason: Mailbox makes failing calls before an account is connected.

recon.title: Mobile has a duplicate call to action and small tap targets
recon.reason: F48a: New Lead in the header and in the floating button's fan (By design). F48b: Small tap targets on Goals and Employees on a phone (Not reproduced).

recon.title: Third-party model name in product copy
recon.reason: Proposals subtitle named a third-party AI model. The subtitle naming the AI model has been removed from Proposals.

recon.title: Slow first search result
recon.reason: First search after the server starts is slower than later ones. Confirmed in part: the first search after the system restarts takes longer while it prepares; later searches answer in about a quarter of a second. We will do that preparation at start-up so the first person does not wait.

recon.title: Money fields reject normal numbers: only '750000.00' is accepted
recon.verdict: Split: Fixed since audit, Bug, Not reproduced
recon.reason: F51a: Partnerships money and count fields refused plain numbers (Fixed since audit). F51b: Custom money fields still refuse amounts typed with commas (Bug). F51c: Money fields in other modules checked for the same fault (Not reproduced).

recon.title: Deals accept a close date in the past and still show 'On Track'
recon.reason: Past close dates accepted and deals never turned Overdue. A deal still being pursued can no longer be given a past close date, and each morning any open deal past its close date turns Overdue. Fixed on 17/11.

recon.title: A deal can be signed with no value
recon.reason: F53a: A deal could be signed with no value (Fixed since audit). F53b: A signed deal's value can be cleared afterwards (Bug).

recon.title: Duplicate check catches only exact names and only warns
recon.reason: F54a: Duplicate warning does not block saving (By design). F54b: Duplicate check misses near names and uses the name only (Gap).

recon.title: Escape closes a multi-step form and discards everything
recon.reason: F55a: Esc in an open date picker closes only the picker (Not reproduced). F55b: Closing a filled form loses the entries without asking (Bug).

recon.title: No budget check: over-budget requests go through and pending spend isn't reserved
recon.reason: F56a: Committed counts approved requests only, not ones still waiting (By design). F56b: Over budget is flagged to approvers, not warned on the form (Improvement). F56c: Spending against a project with no budget is allowed (By design).

recon.title: Expense request skipped the Line Manager stage
recon.reason: F57a: Expense request skipped the line manager for a Program Manager (By design). F57b: A request whose line manager has left waits on the leaver (Bug).

recon.title: New employee record accepts invalid personal, pay and statutory data
recon.reason: F58a: Date of birth allows a six-year-old employee (Improvement). F58b: Gross pay below the minimum wage accepted silently (Improvement). F58c: Tax ID and pension PIN have no format check (Improvement). F58d: Line manager and bank optional when adding an employee (By design).

recon.title: Log Interaction is hidden in the More menu
recon.reason: Log Interaction only reachable from the More menu. Log Interaction now has its own button on the Activity tab of every partner and lead. Fixed on 17/11.

recon.title: Leave form shows the day count only after you send
recon.reason: F60a: Leave form shows working days and balance only after Send (Improvement). F60b: A Saturday counts as one full leave day (By design).

recon.title: Partner returns cannot be saved
recon.reason: F61a: Partner returns could not be saved (Fixed since audit). F61b: Commission not suggested from the category rate (Improvement).

recon.title: AI proposal writing fails
recon.verdict: Split: Fixed since audit, MyCity action
recon.went: Fixed since audit: BG-068; also MA-07
recon.reason: F62a: AI proposal questions hung for minutes with no way forward (Fixed since audit). F62b: AI provider account must be funded for proposals (MyCity action).

recon.title: Closing a partner turns its signed deal into 'Closed Lost'
recon.reason: Closing a partner rewrote its signed deal as lost. Closing a partner now ends its signed deals as Completed, not lost. The test deal closed during the audit still shows the old result and can be corrected on screen.

recon.title: Stages can be skipped, and a lost deal stays 'On Track'
recon.reason: Stages skipped without reason; lost deal still On Track. Skipping stages now needs a written reason kept in the history, and a lost or completed deal shows that instead of On Track. Fixed on 17/11.

recon.title: No duplicate-expense check
recon.reason: F65a: Duplicate requests are detected and flagged on the request (Not reproduced). F65b: Requester is not warned of a likely duplicate before sending (Improvement).

recon.title: Attendance punches create noise and skip key checks
recon.verdict: Split: Improvement, By design, MyCity action
recon.went: Bugs & Gaps: BG-006; also CR-21, MA-09
recon.reason: F66a: One exception per punch from an unregistered device (Improvement). F66b: Clock-in after the shift's end is accepted and marked late (By design). F66c: Remote clock-ins read Not Checked while Home Location is off (MyCity action).

recon.title: Staff cannot record sick leave after the fact
recon.reason: Staff cannot back-date sick leave; HR records it. By design, staff request leave from today on, and HR records sick days after the fact in People · Leave · Record Leave, which accepts past dates (we tested it). Train HR to use it on the person's return.

recon.title: Announcement to an empty department publishes silently, and retired departments are offered
recon.reason: F68a: An announcement to a department with nobody in it publishes silently (Improvement). F68b: Retired departments are offered as announcement audiences (Bug). F68c: A department announcement is posted in the all-staff #announcements channel (By design).

recon.title: Audit log mixes record numbers and raw IDs
recon.reason: Some Audit Log entries name the record by a short ID. Some Partnerships entries in the Audit Log showed an internal code instead of the record's number or name. We will make every entry name its record.

recon.title: Mobile forms put Save/Send at the end of a long scroll
recon.reason: Phone forms put Save and Send at the end of a long scroll. The buttons work and are thumb-sized, but on long forms you have to scroll to reach them. We will pin them to the bottom of the screen on phones, starting with New Request.

recon.title: Candidates can reach an offer without passing any stage
recon.reason: Candidates move between stages freely, without passing gates. Free movement between stages was agreed for M4: scores and tests inform the recruiter but never move or block anyone, and a person always makes the call. If you want the system to ask for a reason when someone skips an unfinished step, tell us and we will add it as a small change.

recon.title: Offers can be made and sent for approval at ₦0 pay
recon.reason: F72a: An offer at ₦0 pay is accepted and sent for approval (Bug). F72b: Vacancies may be published without a pay range (By design).

recon.title: Offer letter ignores the employment type and the company's working week
recon.reason: F73a: One offer letter for every employment type, written for employees (Improvement). F73b: Letter falls back to Monday to Friday hours when the field is blank (MyCity action).

recon.title: Public document check says a genuine offer does not exist
recon.reason: F74a: An offer is verifiable only once everyone has signed (By design). F74b: Verify page wording makes an unsigned genuine letter look forged (Improvement).

recon.title: A leaver still holds full Payroll and Settings rights
recon.reason: F75a: A leaver's login is closed, though the role still lists them (Not reproduced). F75b: Role's people count leaves out closed logins its list shows (Improvement).

recon.title: Salary changes need no approval and leave no before-and-after record
recon.verdict: Split: Out of scope, MyCity action, By design, Bug
recon.went: Bugs & Gaps: BG-046; also CR-08, MA-19
recon.reason: F76a: No approval or effective date for a pay change (Out of scope). F76b: Management can edit pay while Payroll is view only (MyCity action). F76c: Record History names changed fields; Audit Log keeps values (By design). F76d: History shows the UTC date, not the Lagos date (Bug).

recon.title: Reviews pass with unscored lines, and one admin line can earn 'Exceeds'
recon.reason: F77a: Reviewer submits with lines that carry no evidence left unscored (By design). F77b: Rating rests on scored lines only, so one line can read Exceeds (Improvement).

recon.title: Approval chains for money are thin
recon.verdict: Split: By design, Out of scope
recon.reason: F78a: Payroll and expense chains are the agreed ones (By design). F78b: Rule that each approval stage needs a different person (Out of scope).

recon.title: Projects close with open tasks, and work can be assigned to people who cannot log in
recon.went: Bugs & Gaps: BG-028, BG-029; also CR-15
recon.reason: F79a: A project completes with open tasks and no confirmation (By design). F79b: Tasks can be assigned to someone who has no login yet (Improvement). F79c: A leaver's projects cannot be handed to a new owner (Improvement).

recon.title: Interview scorecard is generic, and an early card submit silently does nothing
recon.reason: F80a: Every role rates the same ten interview traits (MyCity action). F80b: Card submitted before the interview appears not to submit (Not reproduced).

recon.title: Applicant scores and application form mislead
recon.reason: F81a: Provisional score shown before the AI read (By design). F81b: Score With AI says "CV read" while the read is only queued (Bug). F81c: Apply link lasts 48 hours, not until the closing date (By design). F81d: Apply step promises questions a role may not have (Improvement). F81e: CV picker offers .doc files the server then refuses (Bug).

recon.title: Status and score labels contradict each other
recon.verdict: Split: By design, MyCity action, Bug
recon.went: Bugs & Gaps: BG-047; also MA-14, MA-15
recon.reason: F82a: Key result reported Done while its score reads 0.45 (By design). F82b: CTO's scorecard sits under Technology while his record says General Management (MyCity action). F82c: CEO's scorecard is Agreed with no reviewer (By design). F82d: Praxis AI calls a person on probation Active (Bug). F82e: Test goals "test run" and "another test" on staging (MyCity action).

recon.title: No way to add or edit an SOP from the Management role
recon.reason: F83a: Management cannot write SOPs unless they head a department (By design). F83b: Marketing and Implementation have no SOPs yet (MyCity action).

meta.subtitle: JBS Praxis response to MyCity's QA audit of staging (16 and 17/11/2026, findings F01 to F83). Every finding was tested or read against the code on main (697f1db) between 24 and 25/11/2026.
howto: Bugs & Gaps is the fix tracker: only verified bugs, gaps, improvements and seed-data fixes. JBS Praxis ticks Fixed ✓ with the PR and date as each fix merges; MyCity records its retest.
Items fixed after the audit are already ticked, with the PR that fixed them, so MyCity can retest them.
To be Discussed (Change Report) holds requests outside the signed milestones, or that change a decision already agreed. Nothing there is built until a change request is agreed.
MyCity Actions are setup, data and policy tasks the hub already supports and MyCity does itself.
Audit Reconciliation shows every one of the 83 findings, our verdict and the sheet it went to.
sheets: The fix tracker. Severity is ours, for go-live. Yellow columns are edited as work proceeds.
Out of scope, or a change to an agreed decision. Record the decision in the yellow columns.
Settings, data and decisions for MyCity, with where in the hub and whether it is needed before go-live.
F01 to F83, MyCity's title and severity, our verdict, and where each went.
footnotes: Verdicts: Bug (wrong against its own specification), Gap (in scope, not built or incomplete), Improvement (works as specified, worth improving), Seed data (our demonstration or staff data), By design (works as agreed, with the decision cited), Not reproduced (tested, the claim did not hold).
A finding may be split into parts (for example F09a, F09b) where only part of it is a bug.
Staging data typed by testers does not reach production: production starts with MyCity's real staff list only.
